profile.name: KAMALISH
profile.headline: Product Manager, building things that actually work.
profile.intro: From discovery to launch, I focus on making the right call at the right time - grounded in data, shaped by users, and built for impact.

software.title: Billing Software
software.summary: An invoicing and billing tool built so a small team can raise a bill, track what is owed and close the loop on payment without living in a spreadsheet.
software.cardDesc: Invoicing and billing built so a small team can raise, track and settle bills without a spreadsheet.
software.problem: Small teams bill in spreadsheets and messaging apps. Invoice numbers drift, totals get recalculated by hand, and nobody can answer "what is still unpaid?" without opening three files.
shipped: Create and send invoices from a reusable line-item template
Automatic numbering, tax and total calculation
Payment status tracking - draft, sent, paid, overdue
A dashboard showing outstanding versus collected
software.role: Scoped the product, defined the data model and the invoice lifecycle, designed the screens, and worked through the edge cases that usually break billing tools: partial payments, edits after sending, and cancelled invoices.

software.title: Desk365 Audit Logs
software.summary: A trustworthy record of every change made inside the helpdesk, so admins can answer "who changed this, and when?" without asking support.
software.cardDesc: A trustworthy record of every change in the helpdesk - events, filters and retention.
software.problem: Admins had no way to see what had changed in their workspace. When a ticket was reassigned, an SLA policy edited or an agent's role changed, the only trail was memory - which made trust and compliance hard.
shipped: A defined catalogue of auditable events across tickets, agents and settings
Filtering by actor, event type and date range
A readable event stream rather than raw system logs
software.role: Owned this feature end to end: defined requirements, wrote the PRD and user stories, decided which events were worth logging, and coordinated Engineering, Design and QA through to release.

software.title: Multiple Support Portals
software.summary: One workspace that lets an organisation run support for several brands - without splitting the team or buying a second helpdesk.
software.cardDesc: One workspace that runs support for several brands without splitting the team.
software.problem: Companies that support more than one brand were forced to choose: run everything through a single generic portal, or pay for separate helpdesk instances and fragment the agent experience.
shipped: Multiple customer-facing portals, each with its own branding
A single agent workspace across all portals
Clear separation of what customers see from how agents work
software.role: Led the feature: framed the multi-brand use case, defined requirements and user stories, and worked with Engineering, Design and QA to prioritise scope and validate the release.

experience.text: Led end-to-end delivery of Audit Logs, Multiple Support Portals and Empty State UX. Owned requirements, PRDs and user stories, and worked with Engineering, Design and QA to prioritise features, validate releases and ship quality launches.

Improved product usability by 50% through user-centric design, prototyping and data-driven UX work. Defined user flows and wireframes that translated user needs and business goals into scalable product experiences.

Led a four-tier team of 80+ students for India's largest student-run technical fest (50k+ footfall). Trained 40+ coordinators, managed a ₹3L+ equipment budget and ran a media campaign that grew social reach by 40%.

Led nationwide outreach for Asia's largest student-run fest, engaging 600+ participants and contributing to an 8% revenue increase on a ₹2 Cr budget. Pioneered Imprints, recruiting 400+ student representatives.
